title: Intemerata dei mater (Johannes Okeghem)
desc: Johannes Okeghem, Intemerata dei mater. 5 voices (Discantus, Contratenor, Tenor, Vagans, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Oke2003); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
